title: Release procedure
description: RELEASING.md per new-dsh-plugin references/release.md (SemVer, prerelease channel matching DSH, exact peer pins, CHANGELOG.md, annotated tag vX.Y.Z[-alpha.N]); CHANGELOG.md. Round 3: cut a release if all required suites green.
acceptance_criteria: RELEASING.md and CHANGELOG.md committed; in round 3 an annotated tag pushed with evidence in CHANGELOG.

title: Bugs and mutation testing
description: Red commit then fix commit per bug; run deliberate mutants against the new tests and record caught N/N in TESTING.md.
acceptance_criteria: Each bug bead has red sha and fix sha; >=3 mutants recorded with caught N/N.

title: TESTING.md traceability
description: TESTING.md table: property ID -> test file/name -> surface -> last result with seed, run count, DSH versions. Every SPEC property maps to >=1 test; no required test silently skips.
acceptance_criteria: Every P-ID in SPEC.md appears in TESTING.md with a test and latest result; a check fails if a P-ID is unmapped.

title: dsh-TUI property tests on real dsh-TUI
description: Generated key/command sequences on Launchpad and in chat (/speed picker, footer lightning) against real dsh-TUI in private tmux socket; invariants after each step; FC_SEED replay.
acceptance_criteria: TUI property suite runs >=25 sequences/round green (>=100 across >=3 seeds for release) with logged seeds; tui.test.js honours FC_SEED.

title: Playwright property tests on real dsh web
description: fast-check generated action sequences against real dsh web (Speed child in Model/Effort menu), invariants after each step, FC_SEED/NUM_RUNS replay, screenshots on failure under a private temp dir.
acceptance_criteria: Web property suite runs >=25 sequences/round while iterating (>=100 across >=3 seeds for release) green; seed logged; failure screenshots saved outside /tmp fixed paths.

title: Vendor the test rig
description: Copy nix-config skills/new-dsh-plugin/scripts/{rig.mjs,mock-llm.mjs} into test/rig with source commit note; import by relative path; never import from ~/.agents.
acceptance_criteria: grep finds no ~/.agents import in test/; e2e files import ./rig/rig.mjs; source commit recorded.

title: Nix flake environment
description: flake.nix + flake.lock: packages.default (version from package.json), devShells.default (node, tmux, Nix Chromium for Playwright, beads, pinned dsh 0.2.1-alpha.2 with model-modal patch, dsh-TUI 0.14.0 with patch-tui), checks running fast suites in sandbox, apps.e2e for real-client suites. nix-dsh pinned to nix-config's rev f0ca0d7.
acceptance_criteria: nix flake check passes; nix develop provides all tools; nix run .#e2e runs real-client suites; built dsh/dsh-TUI match the installed fleet artifacts (or differences documented).

title: SPEC.md with stable property IDs
description: Collect every property from README/UPSTREAM/TESTING/code comments/tests into SPEC.md with stable IDs (P-xx), observable oracle and applicable surfaces; versions; rationale for any not-applicable surface.
acceptance_criteria: Every behaviour claim in README and existing tests maps to a P-ID with oracle + surfaces; SPEC.md committed.

title: Source reconcile with deployed nix-config copy
description: Make main contain the code actually deployed: compare with nix-config pkgs/dsh-speed (vendored) and the installed store artifact; commit a sync if they differ.
acceptance_criteria: diff -r of repo vs nix-config pkgs/dsh-speed and vs installed store path is empty (or a sync commit exists); evidence recorded.

title: Spec-driven real-client test system, Nix env and SemVer releases
description: Give dsh-speed a complete spec-driven, real-client (dsh web + dsh-TUI) property test system, a Nix flake environment, fix bugs it exposes, and a SemVer release procedure. Ralph loop of 3 rounds; state in beads + RALPH.md.
acceptance_criteria: All step beads closed with evidence; release cut in round 3 if every required suite is green.
